title: Intercept a request
summary: intercept can supply a known network response. Set it up before the page sends the request.

blocks.title: Intercept a request

blocks.text: The intercepted request returns a test response with status 200. No book API service is required.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Use a response with an empty list.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A mocked response tests the frontend contract, not a real server implementation.
